name: PARDUS 瑞豹 Super Sport (original generation)
why_interesting: The retained fluorescent limited-color card is the original 22-speed carbon Shimano 105 Super Sport, not Super Sport Gen 2.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7000 mechanical 2×11 (22-speed), with 50/34T crank and 11–28T cassette on the official 105 HDB build
facts.brakes: Shimano 105 R7020 hydraulic disc brakes on the official 105 HDB build
facts.frame_material: HS-EPS carbon frame and HS-HPT carbon fork
facts.cockpit: MVMT M-M-BRONZE HB24 carbon cockpit with internal routing on the official 105 HDB build
facts.sizes: XXS, XS, S, M, L and XL

missing: Complete-bike weight for the photographed fluorescent build with size, pedals, accessories and measurement basis
Maximum tire clearance and meaningful numeric exact-model stiffness evidence
Exact current wheelset/accessory package, checkout conditions and domestic warranty applicability
source_note: The current marketplace index names the fluorescent limited-color original SUPER SPORT as a 22-speed carbon Shimano 105 bike, matching the retained orange seller card. The still-live manufacturer page supplies the original 105 HDB frame and build specification. A reviewed 2021 bike weighed 9.5 kg and was described subjectively as not lacking stiffness, but that build-specific weight and non-numeric impression are not transferred to the photographed current package. Super Sport Gen 2 remains a separate candidate and published platform.
